title: SNTO Claim Ladder
notes: Machine-readable mirror of docs/phase1/SCIENTIFIC_PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md. Loaded and reconciled with src/platform/evidence.py by src/platform/claim_ladder.py (WP-2); the agreement is CI-enforced by tests/unit/test_claim_ladder.py. Source-provenance classes reference src/platform/evidence.py::EvidenceClass. No numeric field-validation threshold (rho/kappa/p/DI) is canonized as product policy; those belong to the approved field-validation protocol and pre-registration (see field_validation_gate).
invariants: SIMULATED, SYNTHETIC and MISSING authorize nothing above L0.
REAL provenance alone never authorizes L6 or L7.
REAL is not the same as OBSERVED: a REAL-provenance DERIVED value (EHS/NDVI) enters at L2, never L1; a MODELLED/HYPOTHESIZED value (SCM) is capped at an L2 hypothesis.
Field validation (#26) is a hard gate for L7 causal attribution.
Restrictive recommendations (closure/quota/access limit) live at L5b and need >=L6 evidence plus owner policy; resource-committing interventions are also L5b.
Municipal MITMA mobility is macro-territorial context only and does not satisfy the visitor-pressure target-variable gate.
No numeric agreement threshold is product policy; L6/L7 require the approved field-validation protocol and pre-registration.
Regenerative Outcome is an evaluation layer, not an evidence pillar, and is out of scope for Phase 1.

field_validation_gate.rule: L6/L7 require satisfying the approved, tracked field-validation protocol (docs/field_validation_protocol.md) and the campaign pre-registration when #26 runs.

cliffs_delta_large_effect_label.role: effect-size label, NOT a causal pass/fail gate

spearman_display_gate.role: UI agreement display gate (with n>=3 and direction_ok)

not_canonized.note: The following appear only in the uncommitted docs/paper1/ draft (another agent) and have no tracked source; they are NOT adopted as product policy.

levels.name: Derived condition
levels.statement: Indicator Y, derived from X, suggests state S.
levels.modelled_hypothesized_cap: SIMULATED/MODELLED values (SCM) may only be shown as an explicit hypothesis at this level.

levels.name: Association
levels.statement: X and Y are associated in this dataset.
levels.sample_note: Minimum plot count follows the tracked field convention (>=3 co-located plots, field_agreement.py); not invented here.

levels.name: Decision-support signal
levels.statement: Evidence is sufficient to flag or prioritize investigation / field inspection.
levels.calibrated_use: context and prioritization only; must be labelled non-observational

levels.name: Observational recommendation
levels.statement: Evidence is sufficient to recommend monitoring / inspection / field verification.

levels.name: Committing recommendation
levels.statement: Evidence is sufficient to recommend a resource-committing intervention or a restrictive action.
levels.blocked_reason: Requires >=L6-grade evidence; the restrictive sub-type additionally requires explicit owner policy sign-off.

levels.name: Effectiveness assessment
levels.statement: After intervention Z, outcome Y changed relative to a comparator.
levels.note: A bare before/after difference without a comparator is only an L2 observation of change, not effectiveness.
permitted_language: outcome changed vs comparator after intervention

levels.name: Causal attribution (high-confidence, BACI-supported)
levels.statement: Under stated assumptions, intervention or pressure X is attributed as the high-confidence cause of outcome Y.
levels.no_mechanical_rule: BACI + a p-value does not by itself establish causality; attribution is quasi-experimental under stated assumptions, not proof.
prohibited_language: any causal or regenerative claim before #26 field validation is ingested
